If I did my math right, Dogecoin's security budget is now ~4 times greater than Litecoin's, but the Litecoin difficulty is much higher than Dogecoin difficultly. Both are scrypt, and DOGE is merge mined with LTC. What gives?

@nicksdjohnson @BrantlyMillegan Merge mining means that Litecoin miners can earn Dogecoin rewards and contribute to Dogecoin security without doing any extra work. It's free money for them. This was added when Litcoin's value/security was muuuch greater than Dogecoin's.

@BrantlyMillegan It's merge mined with Litecoin, which now has much lower security budget than Dogecoin does. Scrypt ASIC's are widely distributed because of LTC. It's certainly possible for Doge to be 51% attacked but I wouldn't say it's likely.
